热闹非凡的问道城（热闹非凡的问道城（第22页）坐定后，牛念娇满脸好奇道，“鼠标哥，那……圣纹？”圣纹二字一出，鼠标眉头紧皱道，“在没有得到武少主准许前，两位圣兽还是要坚守好底线的。此法虽能让我穷奇大陆的很多小辈打破桎梏，我们穷奇殿却不能坏了妖族规矩，让两位圣兽陷入尴尬的困境。”牛念娇依旧满脸好奇道，“鼠标哥，还有一事，你觉不觉得，两位圣兽对我们穷奇殿的依赖是不是过了头，连姚老头都不敢确定的事情，两位圣兽却敢明确的将此消息告知于我们穷奇殿。”事关二次悟道，武书何时出关，关乎很多同辈天骄的未来。按理来说，为了避免不必要麻烦的出现，在没有开始二次悟道前，武书的行踪肯定是处于保密状态的。毕竟，谁都不能保证，已经进入苍源域的这些异大陆或厚土大陆小辈天骄中没有藏着祸心。通过里应外合的方式，将那些闪耀的小辈天骄抹杀掉的事情，在生命的长河中屡见不鲜。“或许吧！”这个问题，鼠标不是没想过，直觉却是告诉鼠标，此事背后涉及的利益关系，绝对不会像表面上看的那么简单。而具体会如何不简单，鼠标却又说不好，故而在牛念娇将这些好奇心问出来时，鼠标的回答也是显得很敷衍。紧接着，牛念娇面露难色道，“鼠标哥，念娇……念娇是说假如，假如接下来武少主给出的感悟真的会影响至深，为了得到这份机缘，来自穷奇大陆的小辈天骄乃至我等真的要立下血誓吗？”这一次，鼠标并没有急着回答什么。而是在看了牛念娇等一眼后，起身道，“两位圣兽先前的所言，诸位皆是听到的。此次前来，我鼠标虽是殿主指明的第一护道人，但在修行一事上，是选择委曲求全，还是坚守本心，我鼠标无权干预诸位的选择。”牛念娇嘟着嘴道，“父亲大人在临行前，有特别叮嘱过念娇，我辈参与宿命之战是为了增加实力境界，不是为了不择手段的击杀敌人，也只有己身足够强大，那些原本看似很强大的敌人才会显得愈加的渺小。鼠标哥，念娇愿意全部听从你的安排。”穷奇殿除了主殿外，还有十二宫，子鼠宫和牛丑宫相邻，两宫小辈关系向来密切。……而这也不知道，鼠标等的这些话是怎么从问道城南一大道嘉庚茶楼中传出的，反正在听到这些消息后，问道城内又是一片哗然。你听！“什么？”“什么情况？”“好好的问道大会，怎么还要立血誓？”“有诈？肯定有诈？”“小心为妙！”“为了能够从此次宿命之战中杀出来，苍源域还真是什么下三滥手段都用出来了。”“如此行事，我看，这问道大会不参加也罢！”“明明灵石能够解决的事情，非要我等立什么血誓，真是太欺负人了。”……因血誓的出现，很多小辈天骄也是开始质疑起悟道大会的初衷。

Chapter 1,099: The bustling city (page 1)
After sitting down in the bustling Wendao City (Busty Wendao City (Page 22)), Niu Nianjiao asked with curiosity on his face, "Brother Mouse, what about... holy pattern?" As soon as the word holy pattern came out, Mouse frowned and said, "Before getting permission from Young Master Wu, the two holy beasts still have to stick to the bottom line. Although this method can allow many juniors in our Qiongqi Continent to break their shackles, we in Qiongqi Palace cannot break the rules of the demon clan and let the two holy beasts Falling into an embarrassing predicament." Niu Nianjiao still said with curiosity on his face, "Brother Mouse, do you think that the two holy beasts' reliance on our Qiongqi Palace is too much? Something that even Old Man Yao is not sure about, but the two holy beasts dare to clearly inform our Qiongqi Palace of this news." It is about the second enlightenment and when Wu Shu will be released, and it is related to the future of many talented people of the same generation. Logically speaking, in order to avoid unnecessary When trouble arises, Wu Shu's whereabouts must be kept secret before he starts his second enlightenment. After all, no one can guarantee that these junior geniuses who have entered the Cangyuan Domain do not have evil intentions. It is not uncommon for those shining junior geniuses to be wiped out through the method of internal cooperation and external cooperation. "Maybe!" Mouse has not thought about this question. However, his intuition tells Mouse that the interests involved behind this matter are definitely not as simple as they appear on the surface. However, Mouse couldn't say how simple it would be, so when Niu Nianjiao asked these curious questions, Mouse's answer seemed very perfunctory. Then, Niu Nianjiao looked troubled and said, "Brother Mouse, Nianjiao... Nianjiao means that if, what if the next insights given by Young Master Wu will really affect In order to get this opportunity, do the young geniuses from Qiongqi Continent and even us really have to make a blood oath?" This time, Mouse did not rush to answer anything. Instead, after taking a look at Niu Nianjiao and others, he stood up and said, "You have heard what the two holy beasts said before. This time, although I, Momomo, are the first guardian designated by the palace master, when it comes to practice, should I choose to compromise or insist on it? Keep your conscience, I, the Mouse, have no right to interfere with your choices." Niu Nianjiao pouted, "My father specifically told Nianjiao that we participate in the fateful battle to increase our strength, not to kill the enemy by any means, and only when we are strong enough, those enemies who originally seemed very powerful will become smaller. "Brother Mouse, Nianjiao is willing to obey your arrangements." In addition to the main hall, there are also the Twelve Palaces, the Zishu Palace and the Niu Chou Palace. The two palaces have always had a close relationship. ...And I don’t know how these words of Mouse and others came from the Jiageng Teahouse on the first avenue in the south of Wendao City. After hearing the news, the city was in an uproar again. "Listen!" Is it a scam?" "It's better to be careful!" "In order to escape from this fateful battle, Cangyuan Territory has really resorted to all kinds of dirty tricks." "In this way, I think it's okay not to participate in the conference!" "It's really bullying to ask me to make a blood oath for something that the spirit stone can solve."... Because of the emergence of the blood oath, many junior geniuses also began to question the original intention of the Enlightenment Conference.
